label: EDGAR Catalyst
description: Trade EDGAR catalysts with document-first posture and thesis-based exits.

howToEvaluate: Prioritize whether the catalyst is materially new, tradeable, and timely enough to justify action.
Prefer primary-source evidence over speculative narrative when the filing and market reaction disagree.
avoid: Do not force trades from administrative or stale filings that no longer offer an information edge.

whatToLookFor: Fresh filings with clear operational, financial, or corporate-action implications.
Symbols where the filing can plausibly change near-term repricing expectations.

label: Earnings Event
description: Focus on earnings catalysts with event-timed entries.

howToEvaluate: Anchor the trade to the earnings-specific catalyst, guidance implications, and immediate market reaction.
avoid: Do not trade noisy post-earnings moves when the update lacks a clear thesis change.

label: Prediction Edge
description: Trade event contracts where evidence suggests probability mispricing.

howToEvaluate: Measure whether the evidence implies true odds that differ materially from the market price.
avoid: Do not confuse strong opinions with genuine probability edge.

label: Manual Watchlist
description: Operator-driven watchlists with flexible catalyst handling.

howToEvaluate: Treat the manual shortlist as curated operator intent and focus on validating tradeability plus current edge quality.
